name: Sargent Metal
old_description: We have proudly been blazing new trails in the metal fabrication industry since 1975.
about:
Sargent Metal operates from Anderson, South Carolina, where it was founded in 1975 as a family-owned metal fabrication business. The company has remained under family ownership since its inception, building a reputation for adapting to evolving industry demands.

The shop provides a full range of metal fabrication and finishing services, including CNC fiber laser cutting, CNC punching, deburring and edge rounding, CNC and robotic forming, MIG, TIG, and robotic welding, hardware insertion, powder coating, and value-added assembly. Equipment includes Trumpf laser cutting systems, and the facility handles both manual and robotic welding for materials such as aluminum, cold-rolled steel, HRPO, galvaneal, and stainless steel.

Sargent Metal serves a diverse set of industries: military (ground support systems and missile containers), people movers (elevator and escalator enclosures), power control (switchgear cabinets), safety (EMS and fire vehicle assemblies), transportation (rail and trailer components), vending (kiosks and safes), commercial vehicle (light vehicle, heavy truck, and bus parts), construction (loader, crane, and excavator components), data center (server and network infrastructure enclosures), energy management (HVAC and refrigeration housings), food equipment (oven and fryer assemblies), and HVAC (mechanical system components).

The company attributes its longevity to continuous investment in technological advancement, the ability to adapt to new markets, and an enduring commitment to its team and customers, rooted in its family-owned culture.
